chapter: Kirby again, Garland gigs and later recordings
title: Personnel on the 'Blues and Jazz from Harlem' session
summary: Holmes and the interviewer name the band: Jack Butler, Happy Caldwell, Jimmy Shirley, Earl Knight and Rick on drums, issued on Saydisk.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Well, Jack Butler was on trumpet.

Jimmy Shirley. And I can't think of the bass player's name. There's always somebody I can't think of their name. Jimmy Shirley and... Funny thing, he plays bass and guitar, this fellow, because him and Jimmy Shirley, they changed their instruments on the record. I think Jimmy Shirley was hired to play guitar, and the other fellow played guitar and Jimmy played bass. Yeah, they were very accomplished musicians. He had a... I don't know who the piano player... I can't think of his name either. He was a very good piano player.
Yeah. That's right. That's who it was. Earl Knight. And Rick was drumming. That's about it.
That was the session. And that came out on a British label called Saydisk(?).
